title: Design: fs-dir backend config and slot mapping
description: Specify the fs-dir backend before writing code. Decisions needed: config macro name (WOLFP11_CFG_FS_DIR_BACKEND), directory config env var or compile-time default, how each .p11k filename maps to a slot index, whether inotify watching is supported (files appearing/disappearing at runtime), PIN handling (same PBKDF2 flow as USB flash), and interaction with the existing slot allocator in wp11_pkcs11.c. Output: written design notes on wolfP11-6ci, no code.
design: 1. Config: compile-time default WOLFP11_CFG_FS_DIR_PATH ("/etc/wolfp11/keys") in wp11_settings.h, overridable at runtime via WOLFP11_FS_DIR_PATH env var. Consistent with WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_WATCH_DIR pattern. 2. Inotify: yes — background thread watches the directory for .p11k files appearing/disappearing, fires C_WaitForSlotEvent. Mirrors wp11_backend_usb_flash.c. 3. Slot mapping: filename encodes slot index. Convention: slot-N.p11k where N is the decimal slot number. Files not matching the pattern are ignored. Gaps allowed. Stable across directory changes — adding slot-5.p11k does not renumber slot-0.
